text:
sam: quick RFC follow-up \u2014 operator playbook for shifting customers from shared-peering to per-tenant ephemeral relays. primary constraints: keep client src IP when possible, avoid lease pool exhaustion on spikes, and have a 1-click fast rollback. need a minimal checklist + exact ops commands.

anya: +1. include a preflight that checks SNAT policy and active long-lived sessions and outputs a risk flag. also require --ticket on every op.

ben: proposed checklist:
1) preflight validate customer (snat, sessions)
2) reserve relay leases in target region (small reserve pool)
3) create & warm relay with probes + certs
4) shadow 2-5% traffic for 10m
5) promote with sticky leases (ttl configurable)
6) monitor & reclaim old leases

ben: example commands:
```bash
# preflight
opsctl customer inspect --customer=cust-555 --fields=snat,active_sessions --ticket=INC-2026-2100
# reserve 15 leases
curl -s -X POST https://ops.internal/egress/v1/leases -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPSTOKEN" -d '{"customer":"cust-555","count":15,"region":"us-west-2"}'
# create & probe relay
opsctl relay create --name=rel-usw2-09 --region=us-west-2 --customer=cust-555 --ticket=INC-2026-2100
opsctl relay probe --relay=rel-usw2-09 --shots=100
# shadow 3% traffic
opsctl route modify --customer=cust-555 --target=rel-usw2-09 --sample=3 --ticket=INC-2026-2100
# promote with sticky ttl
opsctl route promote --customer=cust-555 --target=rel-usw2-09 --sticky-ttl=600 --ticket=INC-2026-2100
```

mira: failure modes and short rollback: if lease_pool_available < 12% trigger autoscale hook and reduce sample to 0. Fast rollback command:
```bash
opsctl route rollback --customer=cust-555 --to=shared-peering --ticket=INC-2026-2100
```

ops-bot: ALERT: lease_pool_available for cust-555 at 11% (threshold 12%). INCIDENT INC-2026-2100 created.

anya: note on sticky ttl: default 600s for request/response workloads, use 1800s for websocket-like flows AND enable lease-refresh endpoint so relays can extend leases for active sessions.

sam: action items: ben -> add lease-refresh endpoint + tests; mira -> add autoscale alert binding; anya -> add preflight validator to opsctl; sam -> draft operator cutover doc and attach commands. keep replies short.
